nodes.name: Resend webhook
nodes.notes: Header-auth credential = a shared secret you also set on the Resend webhook. Without it this URL is an open write endpoint — anyone could forge a 'replied' event and poison the pipeline.

parameters.query:
-- Attach the event to the prospect via the message_id we recorded at send time.
-- A hard bounce or a spam complaint is terminal: stop the sequence AND set
-- do_not_contact, because continuing to mail a complaining recipient is what
-- actually destroys a sending domain.
with target as (
  select prospect_id from public.email_events
   where message_id = $2 and prospect_id is not null
   order by occurred_at asc limit 1
),
ins as (
  insert into public.email_events (prospect_id, message_id, provider, event, payload)
  select target.prospect_id, $2, 'resend', $1, $3::jsonb from target
  returning prospect_id
),
stopped as (
  update public.sequence_enrollments e
     set status = 'stopped', stopped_reason = $1, next_send_at = null
    from target
   where e.prospect_id = target.prospect_id
     and e.status = 'active'
     and $1 in ('bounced','complained')
  returning e.id
)
update public.prospects p
   set do_not_contact = true
  from target
 where p.id = target.prospect_id
   and $1 in ('bounced','complained');

meta.description: Receives Resend delivery events. Bounces and spam complaints stop the sequence and set do_not_contact — the single most important rule for keeping go.fountainbd.com deliverable.
